name: X-Stage Song Studio PC Ready
notes: Verified Windows 10/11 x64 portable ZIP. Bulk head/tail lyrics editor accepts independent StageWeb libraries or raw folders with timed .lrc files (including subfolders), without StageWeb/current.json. It backs up and edits only LRC lyric text, preserves timestamps and MIDI/audio, supports branded/custom replacements and undo. Extract the ZIP and run Start-Song-Studio.cmd.
